title: Lunch invitation
passage: Why do we not discuss the proposal over lunch? A. A lunch menu is included. B. The cafeteria serves lunch until two. C. That works, provided we are back by one.
passageZh:
我們何不吃午餐時討論提案？
A. 附有午餐菜單。
B. 員工餐廳供應午餐到兩點。
C. 可以，只要我們最晚一點回來。
